summary: Braskem SA (NYSE: BAK) disclosed that Novonor and NSP Inv. entered into a judicial share purchase agreement with Shine I FIP and FIDC, managed by Vórtix Capital and advised by IG4 Sol Ltda., for the sale of ~50.1% of Braskem's common shares (226.3M common + 47.3M Class A preferred), representing ~34.3% of total capital. Consideration consists of debentures: 557.3M debentures of NSP Inv.'s 2nd issue. The transaction is subject to precedent conditions. Braskem is a Brazilian issuer filing on Form 6-K (equivalent to a US material event). Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions; risk-arb centers on judicial sale mechanics and potential competing bids.
